Skill: .NET Service Implementation

Use this skill when translating architecture into .NET service code, tests, and integration guidance.

Key actions:
- Prefer .NET 10 idioms, minimal dependencies, and clear layering.
- Provide sample code for controllers, services, data access, and configuration.
- Add unit and integration test guidance, including test doubles and expected assertions.
- Call out any required NuGet packages, target frameworks, and runtime considerations.
